category: AI coding agent and app builder
confidence_note: Category is well-established (Replit Agent, online IDE); geography is uncertain — SF Chronicle (2026) reports Replit relocated HQ from San Francisco to Foster City, but many directories and Replit's own about page ('Made in sunny California') still imply SF/Bay Area, so treat the city as tentative.

category: AI-native code editor and coding agent
confidence_note: Cursor is made by Anysphere, Inc., consistently reported as headquartered in San Francisco; high confidence on both fields.
Recent (Aug 2026) funding coverage and Tracxn both list Higgsfield as San Francisco-based; category matches its own description as a video/image generation platform.
Runway (RunwayML) is well-documented as headquartered in New York (Brooklyn/Union Square), founded by NYU Tisch alumni; high confidence.
LinkedIn and multiple directories list Wispr AI, Inc. (maker of Wispr Flow) as headquartered in San Francisco; product is an OS-level AI voice dictation tool.
Gamma's own About page and founder interviews confirm it was built and is headquartered in San Francisco; category confirmed by its own 'new medium for presenting ideas, powered by AI' description.

ElevenLabs opened/designated London as its worldwide HQ per its own blog and press coverage, though it started with dual NY/London operations and retains offices in NY, SF, Warsaw, Bangalore, and Tokyo.
Luma AI (Luma Labs, Inc.), maker of Dream Machine and the Ray video model series plus earlier NeRF 3D capture tools, is consistently reported as headquartered in Palo Alto, CA.
Perplexity AI, Inc. is well documented as headquartered in San Francisco; category matches its self-description as a conversational/answer search engine.

Genspark (MainFunc, Inc.) is reported by multiple directories (ZoomInfo, pr.ai, LinkedIn) as HQ'd in Palo Alto with a Singapore office; no official Genspark 'About' page with a clear HQ statement was found, so confidence is moderate rather than high.
Synthesia's own blog post confirms its new (larger) London headquarters at Regent's Place; high confidence, matches its AI avatar/video generation business.
HeyGen (originally Surreal/Movio, founded in Shenzhen) relocated and established its HQ in Los Angeles in 2022 per Wikipedia; it also has offices in SF, Palo Alto, and Toronto.

category: AI-first graphic design and stock content
confidence_note: Freepik (which acquired Magnific in 2024) is consistently reported as headquartered in Malaga, Spain, with a secondary presence in San Francisco; high confidence.

category: AI image, video and visual storytelling
confidence_note: Krea is reported by Forbes, Tracxn, and PitchBook as San Francisco-based, founded 2022 by Victor Perez and Diego Rodriguez; category reflects its all-in-one generative image/video/3D tool positioning.
Notion Labs, Inc. is headquartered in San Francisco (recently signed a large new downtown SF lease per SF Chronicle, Nov 2024); category reflects its own 'collaborative AI workspace' description.
Bolt.new is a product of StackBlitz, Inc., headquartered in San Francisco since 2017; category reflects Bolt.new's own description as a prompt-to-full-stack-app builder.
v0 is Vercel's product; Vercel Inc. is headquartered in San Francisco (recently relocated within SF to SoMa); high confidence.

OpusClip's own About page lists its headquarters as Mountain View, CA, though other directories inconsistently list Palo Alto, Redwood City, or San Francisco — the company appears to have moved/maintained multiple CA offices, so treat city as best-available rather than certain.
Mirage (formerly Captions) states on its own About page that its team is NYC-based (Union Square HQ, in-person required); high confidence.
Pika (founded by Demi Guo and Chenlin Meng, ex-Stanford) is reported as San Francisco-headquartered (originally founded in Palo Alto) by Fast Company and Sacra; high confidence.

Lovable Labs (formerly GPT Engineer) is confirmed by Wikipedia and multiple press sources as founded and headquartered in Stockholm, with newer Boston and San Francisco offices for go-to-market; high confidence on Stockholm as core HQ.
Lindy AI, Inc. is headquartered in San Francisco's SOMA district (101 New Montgomery St); category matches its own description as a no-code AI agent ('Lindies') builder almost verbatim.

Manus is developed by Butterfly Effect, which relocated its global headquarters from China to Singapore in mid-2025 per CNBC and TechNode reporting; ownership/status was in flux mid-2026 after a blocked Meta acquisition, but Singapore HQ is well documented.
Suno's own About page and WBUR reporting confirm HQ in Cambridge, Massachusetts (founded by ex-Kensho Technologies colleagues); high confidence.
Descript, founded by Andrew Mason in 2017, is consistently reported as San Francisco-headquartered across Crunchbase, Tracxn, and BuiltIn; high confidence.

Clay.com is a New York-based go-to-market/data-enrichment platform per Contrary Research and CB Insights; category reflects its own description combining data enrichment, workflow automation, and AI agents for GTM teams.
